verses.en: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.
verses.sm: ma ia. Ona faapotopoto mai lea e Mose o le faapotopotoga uma o le fanauga a Isaraelu, ua fai atu ia te i latou, O mea nei ua poloai mai ai le ALII ia faia.

verses.en: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
verses.sm: E ono aso e fai ai galuega, a o le aso fitu e paia lea ia te outou, o le sapati e malolo ai i le ALII; ai se fai galuega ai e fasiotia lava ia.

verses.en: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
verses.sm: Aua neʻi mu se afi i so outou fale i le aso sapati.

verses.en: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Mose i le faapotopotoga uma o le fanauga a Isaraelu, ua faapea atu, O le mea lenei, ua poloai mai ai le ALII, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.sm: Ina fai ia e outou se taulaga i le ALII, e taitoatasi o lē manatu i ai i lona loto, ia au mai e ia le taulaga i le ALII, o le auro, ma le ario, ma le “apa memea,

verses.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.sm: ma le ie uli, ma le páuli, ma le mumu, ma le ie vavae, ma fulufulu ‘oti,

verses.en: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.sm: ma pau mamoe poa faalam: nlaula, ma pa‘u takesa, ma le laau o le setima;

verses.en: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.sm: o le suauu foi e mu aʻi le afi, o mea manogi e manogi a'i le uu e faauu a“, e fai aʻi foi le mea manogi lelei e mu,

verses.en: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.sm: o maa soama, ma maa e teu ai i le efota ma le ufifatafata.

verses.en: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
verses.sm: O i latou uma foi o ia te outou ua popoto, ia latou o mai, ma latou faia mea uma lava ua poloai mai ai le ALII;

verses.en: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.sm: o le malumalu, o lona fale fetafai, ma lona ufiufi, o ona faamau, o ona laupapa, o ona faalava, o ona pou, ma ona lago;

verses.en: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
verses.sm: o le atolaau, ma ona amo, o le nofoa o le alofa, ma le ie puipui;

verses.en: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
verses.sm: o le laoai, ma ona ato, ma ana mea uma lava, ma le areto e laulauina i luma;

verses.en: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
verses.sm: ma le tuugalamepa, e mu ai le afi, ma ana mea, ma ona lamepa, ma le suauu e mu a“ le au;

verses.en: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
verses.sm: ma le fata e mu ai mea manogi, ma ona amo, ma le uu e faauu a“, ma le mea manogi lelei e mu, ma le ie puipui o le faitotoa e pupuni ai le malumalu;

verses.en: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.sm: o le fata e fai ai taulaga mu, ma lona taigaafi ‘apa memea, o ona amo, ma ana mea uma; o le tanoa e mulumulu ai ma lona tulaga;

verses.en: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
verses.sm: o ie puipui mo le lotoá, o ona pou, ma ona lago, ma le ie puipui mo le faitotoa o le lotoā;

verses.en: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
verses.sm: o faamau mo le malumalu, ma faamau mo le lotoá, ma ona maea;

verses.en: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
verses.sm: o ie o mea e fai ai tapuaiga e auauna ai i le mea paia, o ofu sa mo le faitaulaga o Arona, ma ofu o ona atalii, e fai ai le faiva o ositaulaga.

verses.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.sm: Ona tuua lea o le faapotopotoga uma o le fanauga a Isaraelu nai luma o Mose;

verses.en: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD'S offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
verses.sm: ona latou o mai lea, o i latou uma o eE ua uai i ai o latou loto, ma i latou uma o e ua manatu i ai o latou loto, ua latou aumaia le taulaga i le ALII mo le galuega o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga mo ona sauniga uma, atoa ma ofu sa.

verses.en: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua latou o mai, o tane atoa ma fafine; o i latou uma lava o e na manatu i ai o latou loto, ua latou aumaia o mama, ma mama o taliga, ma mama o lima, ma asoa auro, ma mea auro uma, e taitoatasi uma lava o e na fai taulaga, ua fai ai le taulaga auro i le ALII.

verses.en: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.
verses.sm: E taitoatasi uma foi ua i ai se ie uli, ma le pāuli, ma le múmú, ma le ie vavae, ma fulufulu “on, ma pa'u mamoe poa faalanu ulaula, ma pa‘u takesa, ua latou aumaia.

verses.en: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD'S offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
verses.sm: E taitoatasi uma o e na faitaulaga i le ario, ma le ‘apa memea, ua au mai e ia le taulaga i le ALII; e taitasi uma foi na i ai laau o le setima e aoga i se mea o le galuega, ua aumaia.

verses.en: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
verses.sm: O fafine taitoatasi uma foi ua atamamai, ua milo i o latou lima, ma au mai o mea na milo, o le ie uli, ma le páuli, ma le múmú, ma le ie vavae.

verses.en: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.
verses.sm: O fafine uma foi na uai i ai o latou loto ma le poto, ua milo e i latou fulufulu ‘oti.

verses.en: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
verses.sm: O alii foi, ua au mai e i latou O maa soama, ma maa e teu ai i le efota ma le ufifatafata;

verses.en: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.sm: ma le mea manogi, ma le suáuu e mu a“ le au, ma le uu e faauu a“, atoa ma le mea manogi lelei e mu.

verses.en: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
verses.sm: E taitoatasi uma o tane atoa ma fafine e na manatu i ai i o latou loto, ua aumaia mea e fai a‘i galuega uma lava na poloai mai ai le ALII ia Mose ia faia; ua aumaia ma le loto e le fanauga a Isaraelu i le ALII.

verses.en: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu lea o Mose i le fanauga a Isaraelu, Faauta, ua valaauina e le Alii i lona lava igoa 0 Pesaleli, o le atalii o Auri, o le atalii lea o Huro, o le itu aiga o Tuta;

verses.en: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
verses.sm: ua faatumuina foi o ia i le Agaga o le Atua i le poto, ma le faautauta, ma le iloa lelei, e fai ai galuega uma lava;

verses.en: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.sm: ina ia mafaufau o ia i galuega faigata, e galue o ia i le auro, ma le ario, ma le “apa memea;

verses.en: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
verses.sm: e togitogi foi i maa c faamau ai, e togitogi foi i laau, e fai ai galuega faigata uma lava.

verses.en: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.sm: Ua ia tuuina i lona loto ia mafai ona aʻoaʻo atu, o ia atoa ma Aliavu, o le atalii o Aisamako, o le itu aiga o Tanu.

verses.en: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
verses.sm: Ua na faatumuina foi i laua i le poto e fai galuega uma a le tufuga togitogi mea, ma le galuega a le tufuga poto, ma lē lalaga ie lanu eseese, o le ie uli, ma le pāuli, ma le múmú, ma le ie vavae, atoa ma le galuega a E lalaga mea, ma matá galuega eseese, ma galuega a E mafaufau i galuega faigata.
